correlate.executive_summary: The assessment identified several HTTP hardening issues and platform disclosure information but no confirmed product-specific vulnerabilities. Multiple common security headers (HSTS, X-Content-Type-Options, X-Frame-Options, Content-Security-Policy, Referrer-Policy) were not present, which increases risk from clickjacking, MIME-sniffing, and cross-site injection vectors. The application appears hosted on Heroku (server/router headers). Nikto also reported presence of browser reporting-related headers (NEL/report-to/reporting-endpoints) — these are informational but worth reviewing. No matching CVE data was available for any detected product/version, so no findings were upgraded based on CVEs.

findings.title: Missing HTTP security headers (HSTS, X-Content-Type-Options, X-Frame-Options, Content-Security-Policy, Referrer-Policy)
findings.evidence: recon: HTTP response did not set strict-transport-security, x-content-type-options, x-frame-options, content-security-policy, or referrer-policy. va/nikto: The anti-clickjacking X-Frame-Options header is not present (nikto GET https://juice-shop.herokuapp.com:443/).

findings.evidence: recon: Detected: Heroku via Server header hint. va/nikto: Retrieved via header: '1.1 heroku-router' (nikto GET https://juice-shop.herokuapp.com:443/).

findings.title: Uncommon reporting headers present (NEL / report-to / reporting-endpoints)
findings.evidence: va/nikto: Uncommon header 'reporting-endpoints' found with contents heroku-nel=..., 'report-to' found with JSON pointing to https://nel.heroku.com/reports..., and 'nel' header present ({"report_to":"heroku-nel",...}) (nikto GET https://juice-shop.herokuapp.com:443/).
